direction: down

classes: {
  # Layer 1: Universal Core (Sky Blue)
  core_box: {
    shape: rectangle

      stroke-width: 3

    }
  }

  # Layer 2: Method-Specific Extensions (Teal — all uniform)
  method_ext: {
    shape: rectangle

      fill: "#99F6E4"
      stroke: "#0F766E"
      stroke-width: 3
      border-radius: 10
      font-size: 20
      bold: true
    }
  }

  # Layer 3: Packaging / Serialization (Amber Rectangle)
  package_box: {
    shape: rectangle
    width: 440
    height: 75
    style: {
      fill: "#FDE68A"
      stroke: "#B45309"
      stroke-width: 3
      border-radius: 10
      font-size: 20
      bold: true
    }
  }
}
